raw_payload.author: Will Healy
raw_payload.description: The article recommends holding three AI stocks—Nvidia, Amazon, and Apple—as defensive positions during economic uncertainty. Despite elevated market valuations (Shiller P/E at 38), these companies possess strong balance sheets, market leadership, and solid fundamentals that should help them weather potential downturns. Nvidia leads in AI chips with 65% revenue growth, Amazon dominates e-commerce and cloud computing with 31% profit growth, and Apple is benefiting from an iPhone upgrade cycle with 16% revenue growth.

iPhone upgrade cycle driving 16% revenue growth and 23% iPhone sales increase. Strong liquidity of $132 billion, 16% profit growth, and market leadership in smartphone ecosystem support resilience. Warren Buffett's recent regret at reducing holdings validates long-term appeal.
